Subject: SI Enablement request — sandbox + bootcamp

Hey Jordan,

Great talking yesterday — thanks again for the overview of Redwood Dedicated. Stratus is ready to move from evaluation to a co-delivery pilot. To get our consultants ramped quickly we need:

- A partner sandbox with sample datasets mirroring our typical customer workloads (3 projects, each ~10GB)
- A two-day practitioner bootcamp for 8 SI engineers (hands-on + CI/CD integration)
- An MLP (mutual action plan) so procurement and delivery are aligned

We attached a short proposal (Stratus_MA_Plan_v1.pdf) with suggested milestones and target dates. Our preferred week for the bootcamp is Nov 16–17, but we can be flexible if you have capacity earlier. Can you confirm sandbox access model (SAML vs token), estimated lead time for provisioning, and whether Redwood will provide sample ingestion scripts?

Thanks — looking to lock this in so we can get purchase order over the line.

—Matt

Hi Matt — really glad to hear Stratus is moving forward. High level next steps from our side: 

1) Sandbox provisioning: we can stand up a partner sandbox (isolated project) within 5 business days after we have the SSO owner and the dataset ingest details. Options: SAML SSO (preferred for persistent partner accounts) or short-lived API tokens for quick access.

2) Bootcamp: we can run a 2-day practitioner track. Proposed agenda is hands-on model serving, cost tuning (batching + cache), and CI/CD with Canary rollouts. We’ll share a draft agenda and trainer list.

3) MLP: we reviewed your attached MA plan. Laura will lead contracting questions, Jonas will handle sandbox ops and lead the trainer team. Vivek will be the field-engagement lead for success metrics.

Can you confirm: who will be our technical point of contact for SSO/SAML, and can you share a sample dataset manifest? Once we have that we’ll circulate a provisioning checklist (sandbox-access-instructions.md) and a final bootcamp agenda.

I’m looping in Jonas and Laura to scope the delivery.

Best,

Hi Matt / Team — quick technical checklist to speed provisioning:

- SSO: If you want SAML, provide IdP metadata XML and SAML attribute mapping (email, name, groups). If you prefer tokens, provide names + emails for each partner account.
- Dataset ingest: a manifest CSV with columns: project_name, file_path, size_bytes, sample_rate. We can accept S3 presigned URLs or direct HTTPS pulls.
- Access scope: please confirm whether the partner sandbox can have outbound internet access for model downloads (we can provide air-gapped options if not).
- Quota: default quota is 4 v100-equivalents for pilot; let us know if you need larger.

Technical attachments: sandbox-access-instructions.md (provisioning steps, firewall rules), sample-ingest-script.sh (S3->ingest). I can provision the environment once we have the IdP metadata or list of accounts.

If Nov 16–17 is still the target, we need sandbox confirmation by Nov 9 (EOD) to run a dry-run on Nov 13.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
